title: Death Note
synopsis:
Brutal murders, petty thefts, and senseless violence pollute the human world. In contrast, the realm of death gods is a humdrum, unchanging gambling den. The ingenious 17-year-old Japanese student Light Yagami and sadistic god of death Ryuk share one belief: their worlds are rotten.

For his own amusement, Ryuk drops his Death Note into the human world. Light stumbles upon it, deeming the first of its rules ridiculous: the human whose name is written in this note shall die. However, the temptation is too great, and Light experiments by writing a felon's name, which disturbingly enacts his first murder.

Aware of the terrifying godlike power that has fallen into his hands, Light—under the alias Kira—follows his wicked sense of justice with the ultimate goal of cleansing the world of all evil-doers. The meticulous mastermind detective L is already on his trail, but as Light's brilliance rivals L's, the grand chase for Kira turns into an intense battle of wits that can only end when one of them is dead.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Asesinatos brutales, pequeños robos y violencia sin sentido contaminan el mundo humano. Por el contrario, el reino de los dioses de la muerte es un garito de juego monótono e inmutable. El ingenioso estudiante japonés de 17 años Light Yagami y el sádico dios de la muerte Ryuk comparten una creencia: sus mundos están podridos.

Para su propia diversión, Ryuk deja caer su Death Note en el mundo humano. Light tropieza con él, considerando ridícula la primera de sus reglas: el humano cuyo nombre está escrito en esta nota morirá. Sin embargo, la tentación es demasiado grande y Light experimenta escribiendo el nombre de un delincuente, lo que representa de manera inquietante su primer asesinato.

Consciente del aterrador poder divino que ha caído en sus manos, Light, bajo el alias Kira, sigue su perverso sentido de la justicia con el objetivo final de limpiar el mundo de todos los malhechores. El meticuloso detective L ya está tras su rastro, pero a medida que la brillantez de Light rivaliza con la de L, la gran persecución de Kira se convierte en una intensa batalla de ingenio que sólo puede terminar cuando uno de ellos está muerto.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Rebirth
episodes_data.description: Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hands—the power of the Death Note.

episodes_data.title: Confrontation
episodes_data.description: While the world’s criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.

episodes_data.title: Dealings
episodes_data.description: Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.

episodes_data.title: Pursuit
episodes_data.description: Light—now known to the world as Kira—tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways…

episodes_data.title: Tactics
episodes_data.description: Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan.

episodes_data.title: Unraveling
episodes_data.description: Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force.

episodes_data.title: Overcast
episodes_data.description: Light uses the Death Note to try to get rid of the woman who could get him captured, and is shocked when it doesn`t work.

episodes_data.title: Glare
episodes_data.description: L insists on setting up bugs and cameras in the homes of Chief Yagami and Deputy Director Kitamura...

episodes_data.title: Encounter
episodes_data.description: The murders continue, and L grows suspicious of Light`s too-perfect behavior and decides to investigate him on his own.

episodes_data.title: Doubt
episodes_data.description: L`s suspicion of Light deepens, compelling him to invite Light into the investigation.

episodes_data.title: Assault
episodes_data.description: As predicted on the tapes sent to Sakura TV, news anchors and commentators who expressed doubt about Kira die one by one.

episodes_data.title: Love
episodes_data.description: With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat.

episodes_data.title: Confession
episodes_data.description: Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious.

episodes_data.title: Friend
episodes_data.description: Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L.

episodes_data.title: Wager
episodes_data.description:
Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira.
Srouce: crunchyroll

episodes_data.title: Decision
episodes_data.description: Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away.

episodes_data.title: Execution
episodes_data.description: After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released.

episodes_data.title: Ally
episodes_data.description: Though L is still suspicious, Light and Misa, their memories of being Kira wiped clean, return to headquarters...

episodes_data.title: Matsuda
episodes_data.description: Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself...

episodes_data.title: Makeshift
episodes_data.description: L`s team discover that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company...

episodes_data.title: Performance
episodes_data.description: The Yotsuba Group hires Eraldo Coil to uncover L`s identity

episodes_data.title: Guidance
episodes_data.description: Misa succeeds in narrowing down the Kira suspects in the Yotsuba Group to one: Higuchi.

episodes_data.title: Frenzy
episodes_data.description: Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group attempts to kill Matsuda of the task force, and is surprised when he doesn`t die after 40 seconds.

episodes_data.title: Revival
episodes_data.description: Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.

episodes_data.title: Silence
episodes_data.description: Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.

episodes_data.title: Renewal
episodes_data.description: Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.

episodes_data.title: Abduction
episodes_data.description: A new investigator steps forward—Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.

episodes_data.title: Impatience
episodes_data.description: Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.

episodes_data.title: Father
episodes_data.description: Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa`s eyes to find the Death Note`s current owner.

episodes_data.title: Justice
episodes_data.description: Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won`t be killed by Kira.

episodes_data.title: Transfer
episodes_data.description: Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.

episodes_data.title: Selection
episodes_data.description: Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira`s spokesperson to the world...

episodes_data.title: Scorn
episodes_data.description: Light pretends to investigate Kiyomi...

episodes_data.title: Vigilance
episodes_data.description: Aizawa figures out what`s going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes.

episodes_data.title: Malice
episodes_data.description: Light gives Kiyomi the order to finish off Near.
Near, along with the SPK, meets Light and the task force at a warehouse for the final showdown.

episodes_data.title: New World
episodes_data.description: Though Mikami has written all the investigators` names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive.
